theorems.name: Submission.codim1_hcp_sc_tangent_normal_complement
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (A₀ : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (ν : Euclid P → Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ A₀ = m + 1 → M ⊆ (A₀ : Set (Euclid P)) → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m M → (∀ x ∈ M, ν x ∈ A₀ ∧ ‖ν x‖ = 1 ∧ ∀ v ∈ tangentSpace M x, inner ℝ (ν x) v = 0) → ∀ x ∈ M, tangentSpace M x = {v : Euclid P | v ∈ A₀ ∧ inner ℝ (ν x) v = 0} ∧ ∀ w : Euclid P, (Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection w = A₀.starProjection w - inner ℝ (ν x) w • ν x
